title: Clinical Trial Stages & Informed Consent
goal: Sequence clinical procedures using antes de que + subjunctive, después de que + compound/past tenses and después de haber + participle.

items: I can use *antes de que* + subjunctive for clinical procedures involving a subject shift or passive *se*.
I can contrast *después de que* + perfect subjunctive (future milestone) with indicative (past event) and *después de haber* + participle.
I can use key terms for informed consent, clinical trials, diagnosis and prescribing medication.
